paper_metadata.title: Novel Al-Sc-Ti-Zr multi-principal element alloys with outstanding mechanical properties

evidence.quote: Non-equiatomic multi-principal element alloys, namely Al5Sc25Ti35Zr35, Al10Sc20Ti35Zr35 and Al15Sc15Ti35Zr35, with a density of approximately 4.95 × 103 kg/m3, were prepared by casting and subsequently treated with dual-annealing.

Each sample was melted and flipped four times to ensure the homogeneity, with a Ti-ball as the getter.
